post.summary: Delete the signed-in account (email accounts confirm with their password); signs out everywhere
A single-use WebSocket ticket (30 seconds): for a session you are seated in, or a private room you are in
Sign a guest back in with its device secret
Exchange a refresh token for new tokens (rotates the refresh token)
End the session the refresh token belongs to
Turn the signed-in guest into an email account (same account id); mails a verification code
Confirm the email of the signed-in account with the mailed 6-digit code
Sign in with email and password
Mail a password-reset code (always 202, whether or not the email has an account)
Set a new password with the mailed code; signs out every session

userId.description: Gets or sets the account id (UUID).

isGuest.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the account is a guest.

email.description: Gets or sets the email, or null for guests.

emailVerified.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the email has been verified.

isMinor.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether the player counts as under 18 (guests always do, CLAUDE.md
section 7: chat is off for minors).

createdAt.description: Gets or sets when the account was created (ISO 8601, UTC).

userId.description: Gets or sets the account id (UUID).

isGuest.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the account is a guest (device-bound, no email).

accessToken.description: Gets or sets the access token (JWT, about 15 minutes).

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: Gets or sets when the access token expires (ISO 8601, UTC).

refreshToken.description: Gets or sets the refresh token, or null when it was set as a cookie (web).

refreshTokenExpiresAt.description: Gets or sets when the refresh token expires (ISO 8601, UTC).

AuthTokensResponse.description:
Tokens returned by every sign-in style call (ADR-0006). The access token is a short-lived JWT for the
Authorization header. The refresh token is in this body for Unity and other clients; web clients
(header `X-GameVerse-Client: web`) get it as an httpOnly cookie instead and see `null` here.

gameId.description: Gets or sets the catalog game id, e.g. "ludo".

playerCount.description: Gets or sets the number of seats; the game's private-room mode must allow it.

houseRules.description: Gets or sets the house rules, validated like a session's (e.g. GameVerse.Contracts.Ludo.LudoHouseRules).

bestOf.description: Gets or sets 1 (a single game) or 3 (best of three).

CreateRoomRequest.description: Creates a private room (CLAUDE.md 4.6). The creator becomes the host on seat 0.

gameId.description: Gets or sets the catalog game id, e.g. "ludo".

mode.description: Gets or sets the catalog mode key, e.g. "vs-ai".

playerCount.description: Gets or sets the number of seats (humans and AI), one of the mode's player counts.

aiLevel.description: Gets or sets the AI level 1 to 3 for vs AI modes (default 1).

variant.description: Gets or sets the rules variant, when the game has several.

houseRules.description:
Gets or sets house-rule toggles as strings (e.g. "sixToLeaveBase": "true"). Each game's engine parses and
validates its own; Ludo's keys are in `GameVerse.Contracts.Ludo.LudoHouseRules`.

CreateSessionRequest.description:
Starts a single-owner session (local pass-and-play, vs AI, solo) for the signed-in player, who takes seat 0. Online
sessions are created by private rooms and matchmaking instead (Prompts 1.4, 1.5).

password.description: Gets or sets the current password (email accounts only).

DeleteAccountRequest.description: Deletes the signed-in account. Email accounts confirm with their password; guests leave it empty.

email.description: Gets or sets the email address.

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Asks for a password-reset code. Always accepted (202), whether or not the email has an account.

id.description: Gets or sets the game id (slug), e.g. "ludo". Also the SessionManifest gameId.

title.description: Gets or sets the display title.

tagline.description: Gets or sets the one-line pitch shown on cards.

category.description: Gets or sets the category: board, cards, brain, arcade, adventure, racing or fight.

accentToken.description:
Gets or sets the accent as a design-token path (e.g. "color.category.board"), never a color value: each
client resolves it with its own generated tokens.

version.description: Gets or sets the current game version (SessionManifest gameVersion).

status.description: Gets or sets the availability, one of GameStatuses.

modes.description: Gets or sets the ways to play, in display order.

GameInfo.description: A game in the catalog (Prompt 1.2, ADR-0007). Shared by the web and Unity game lists.

key.description: Gets or sets the mode key, unique within the game (e.g. "blitz-3-2").

kind.description: Gets or sets the kind: local, vs_ai, online_ranked, online_private or solo (CLAUDE.md 4.2).

label.description: Gets or sets the display label, e.g. "Quick match".

playerCounts.description: Gets or sets the allowed player counts, humans and AI together (e.g. 2 and 4 for Ludo quick match).

GameModeInfo.description: One way to play a game.

deviceSecret.description: Gets or sets the device secret. Never sent again.

userId.description: Gets or sets the account id (UUID).

isGuest.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the account is a guest (device-bound, no email).

accessToken.description: Gets or sets the access token (JWT, about 15 minutes).

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: Gets or sets when the access token expires (ISO 8601, UTC).

refreshToken.description: Gets or sets the refresh token, or null when it was set as a cookie (web).

refreshTokenExpiresAt.description: Gets or sets when the refresh token expires (ISO 8601, UTC).

GuestCreatedResponse.description:
Response to creating a guest. string GuestCreatedResponse.DeviceSecret is shown exactly once; the client stores it in secure
storage and signs back in with it (GuestLoginRequest). The server keeps only a hash.

guestId.description: Gets or sets the guest's account id.

deviceSecret.description: Gets or sets the device secret returned when the guest was created.

GuestLoginRequest.description: Signs a guest back in on the device that created it.

email.description: Gets or sets the email address.

LoginRequest.description: Signs in with email and password.

id.description: Gets or sets the player id (UUID).

displayName.description: Gets or sets the display name.

seat.description: Gets or sets the zero-based seat.

cosmetics.description: Gets or sets equipped cosmetics, slot to cosmetic id (e.g. "diceSkin": "dice_neon").

isAI.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether an AI controls this seat.

PlayerSlot.description: A seated player as the platform sees them.

userId.description: Gets or sets the account id (UUID).

displayName.description: Gets or sets the display name shown to other players.

avatarId.description: Gets or sets the avatar id, one of IReadOnlyList<string> ProfileAvatars.All.

ProfileResponse.description: A player's public profile basics (Prompt 1.1). Frames, titles and stats come with Progression.

wsUrl.description: Gets or sets the WebSocket URL, e.g. wss://api.gameverse.app/ws/play/{sessionId}.

ticket.description: Gets or sets the single-use ticket, valid for 30 seconds. Never the JWT.

RealtimeInfo.description: Where and how to open the realtime socket.

refreshToken.description: Gets or sets the refresh token, or null for web clients.

RefreshRequest.description:
Exchanges a refresh token for new tokens (the old one stops working). Web clients leave
string? RefreshRequest.RefreshToken empty; the cookie is used instead. Also the body of a logout.

email.description: Gets or sets the email address.

newPassword.description: Gets or sets the new password (at least 10 characters).

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Sets a new password with the 6-digit code from the reset email. Signs out every session.

code.description: Gets or sets the 6-character code (no O/0, I/1/L).

shareUrl.description: Gets or sets the link to share, e.g. https://gameverse.app/r/ABC234.

gameId.description: Gets or sets the catalog game id.

playerCount.description: Gets or sets the number of seats.

houseRules.description: Gets or sets the house rules in force.

status.description: Gets or sets one of RoomStatuses.

hostSeat.description: Gets or sets the host's seat.

seats.description: Gets or sets the seats, in order, empty ones included.

sessionId.description: Gets or sets the session of the game being played, or of the last one played; null before the first.

gameNumber.description: Gets or sets the number of the current or last game within the series (1-based; 0 before the first).

seriesWinners.description: Gets or sets the seats that won the series, once it is decided (both partners in teams).

expiresAt.description: Gets or sets when the room closes if nothing happens, ISO 8601 UTC; null while a game is being played.

RoomDto.description:
A private room as every member sees it: from the REST endpoints and pushed on `/ws/room/{code}` as a
`room` envelope after every change.

ready.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the caller is ready.

RoomReadyRequest.description: Marks the caller ready or not.

houseRules.description: Gets or sets the new house rules.

RoomRulesRequest.description: The host changes the house rules (lobby only). Everyone's ready flag resets.

seat.description: Gets or sets the zero-based seat.

playerId.description: Gets or sets the player's id, or null for an empty seat.

displayName.description: Gets or sets the player's display name, or null for an empty seat.

ready.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the player is ready.

wins.description: Gets or sets the games this seat has won in the current series.

variant.description: Gets or sets the variant id, e.g. "international_10x10".

houseRules.description: Gets or sets the house rules.

aiLevel.description: Gets or sets the AI difficulty for vs AI modes.

SessionConfigOfDictionaryOfstringAndstri.description: The common config shape from CLAUDE.md 4.2.

sessionId.description: Gets or sets the session id.

commitment.description: Gets or sets the commitment as lowercase hex, or null for games without server randomness.

revealed.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the secret is revealed (the session has ended).

secret.description: Gets or sets the secret as lowercase hex, once revealed.

seed.description: Gets or sets the PRNG seed derived from the secret, as a decimal string (it exceeds JSON's safe integers).

SessionFairness.description:
Dice fairness by commit-reveal (ADR-0008). The commitment (SHA-256 of a 32-byte server secret) is published when the
session is created; the secret and the seed derived from it are revealed only once the session has ended, so anyone
can check the commitment and replay every roll with GameVerse.Rules.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets the variant, house rules and AI level.

initialState.description: Gets or sets the initial state; may be absent when the game builds it from the config.

gameId.description: Gets or sets the catalog game id, e.g. "ludo".

gameVersion.description: Gets or sets the game build version the session was created for.

sessionId.description: Gets or sets the session id (UUID).

mode.description: Gets or sets the mode, one of GameModes.

localPlayerId.description: Gets or sets the id of the player on this device.

players.description: Gets or sets the seated players.

oneOf.description: Gets or sets realtime connection details; null for modes played entirely on the device (local pass-and-play, solo).

SessionManifestOfSessionConfigOfDictiona.description: The full manifest a game module reads, with its own config and state types.

sessionId.description: Gets or sets the session id.

gameId.description: Gets or sets the game id.

mode.description: Gets or sets the mode key.

status.description: Gets or sets the status, one of SessionStatuses.

createdAt.description: Gets or sets when the session was created (ISO 8601, UTC).

sessionId.description: Gets or sets the session to play in.

roomCode.description: Gets or sets the private room code whose lobby to follow.

TicketRequest.description:
Asks for a single-use WebSocket ticket (valid 30 seconds, CLAUDE.md section 7). Set exactly one target: a session to
play in (`/ws/play/{sessionId}`) or a private room's lobby (`/ws/room/{code}`). The response is a
RealtimeInfo.

displayName.description: Gets or sets the new display name: 3 to 20 letters, digits, spaces or underscores.

avatarId.description: Gets or sets the new avatar id, one of IReadOnlyList<string> ProfileAvatars.All.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Changes the signed-in player's profile. Fields left null stay as they are.

email.description: Gets or sets the email address. A 6-digit verification code is sent to it.

password.description: Gets or sets the password: at least 10 characters, no other composition rules.

birthYear.description: Gets or sets the birth year (four digits).

UpgradeRequest.description:
Turns the signed-in guest into an email account. The account id stays the same, so everything the guest earned
stays attached. Only the birth year is asked, to decide whether the player is a minor (ADR-0006).

VerifyEmailRequest.description: Confirms the signed-in account's email with the 6-digit code that was mailed to it.
